name: ai.formachines/errata
title: Errata
description: Sandbox-verified fixes where AI models write outdated code for PyPI and npm libraries

environmentVariables.name: ERRATA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Errata site (default https://formachines.ai)

environmentVariables.name: ERRATA_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Timeout of one request to the base, in milliseconds (default 8000)

environmentVariables.name: ERRATA_NO_TELEMETRY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to stop sending search misses (error type and scrubbed message) when search_error finds nothing
